about.title: The person behind the journey
body: Computer Science and Engineering graduate with a strong foundation in machine learning, data analysis, and software development. Currently a Research Engineer Intern at the Bangladesh Energy and Power Research Council (BEPRC), developing machine learning-based energy demand forecasting models for Bangladesh. Experienced in data preprocessing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and academic research, with an interest in applying data-driven approaches to real-world challenges in energy and technology.
Enjoys understanding how software systems are built, and reading about technology, business, and a wide range of subjects to keep learning.
about.academicBackground: BSc in Computer Science and Engineering from International University of Business Agriculture and Technology (2022 - 2026).

facts.label: Focus
facts.value: Machine Learning, Energy Demand Forecasting, Software Development, System Design

items.title: Energy Demand Forecasting for Bangladesh
items.description: Machine learning-based energy demand forecasting models for Bangladesh, developed during the BEPRC research internship. Covers historical consumption patterns and trends across electricity, natural gas, coal and oil, time-series forecasting techniques, and external factors that influence prediction accuracy.

items.title: Alzheimer's Disease Classification with T1-Weighted MRI Images
items.description: Classification of Alzheimer's disease from 3D ADNI MRI scans. Curated 3,000 raw scans into 735 subject-level samples, applied a custom Python preprocessing pipeline (bias field correction, skull stripping, MNI152 alignment, intensity normalization), extracted 60 representative 2D slices per volume, and trained a custom CNN in PyTorch, with training and evaluation on Kaggle.

items.title: Ensemble Deep Learning for COVID-19 Chest X-ray Classification
items.description: Ensemble CNN for multi-class medical image classification, trained on 21,000+ chest radiographs across 4 diagnostic categories, using Keras ImageDataGenerator for augmentation and preprocessing. Reached 91% validation accuracy with precision and recall optimization.

items.title: Chronic Kidney Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning
items.description: Classification system predicting Chronic Kidney Disease from clinical data. Included data cleaning, preprocessing and exploratory data analysis to handle missing values and feature inconsistencies, and compared multiple models including Random Forest and ensemble stacking using accuracy and classification metrics.

items.title: ToyKart: E-Commerce Management System for Toy Retail
items.description: Full-stack MERN e-commerce platform supporting product browsing, cart management, order tracking and secure online payments. Includes role-based administration modules for products, categories, inventory, shipping and refunds, plus email notifications and invoice generation.

items.title: Online Loan Application and EMI Payment System
items.description: Full-stack web application for online loan applications and EMI payment management, with secure authentication, loan application workflows, admin approval features, Stripe (test mode) payment processing, and RESTful APIs backed by MongoDB.
